title: Singapore's Support for Global Conservation Targets set at COP15 Biodiversity Conference
what_it_is: Singapore's Support for Global Conservation Targets set at COP15 Biodiversity Conference

sections.label: Singapore biodiversity conservation contributions
sections.summary: Countries contribute to global targets per national circumstances; Singapore shares expertise, designates ASEAN Heritage Parks and safeguards green spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Countries are expected to contribute towards the global targets under this Framework according to their national circumstances, priorities and capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, Singapore contributes towards regional conservation efforts by sharing our technical expertise in areas such as protected area management and conservation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We have also designated the Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve and Bukit Timah Nature Reserve as ASEAN Heritage Parks under the ASEAN Heritage Parks Programme, which recognises these as protected areas of high conservation importance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As part of our City in Nature efforts, we are safeguarding more green spaces where possible, establishing additional nature parks, and restoring core habitats.

sections.label: Kunming-Montreal Framework action targets
sections.summary: The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework contains 23 action targets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: To the point that the Member has raised on the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, there are 23 action targets under this Framework.

sections.label: 30 by 30 and updated Plan
sections.summary: Target 3 is 30 by 30; NParks is updating the National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan for submission before COP 16 in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The "30 by 30" is one of the targets, Target 3 under the Framework, and Singapore is actively contributing to that global target.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In fact, as part of an earlier Parliamentary Question (PQ) by another Member Mr Louis Ng, we also shared with the House that National Parks Board (NParks) is working closely with relevant agencies and stakeholders – for example, our local biodiversity groups and different non-governmental organisations (NGOs) – to update our National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan, and to develop national targets to further contribute to this Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As part of this process, we aim to submit our updated Plan prior to the 16th meeting of the Conference of Parties (COP) to the Convention on Biodiversity in 2024.
